statistics.subtitle: Members ranked by average stars per war (maximum 6: two 3-star attacks)
statistics.historyEmpty: The history is still empty: every war is added automatically when it ends.
statistics.periodEmpty: No wars recorded in this period.
statistics.table: Player ranking by average stars per war
statistics.defenseTooltip: Average stars conceded to the opponent on defense, per war (lower is better)
statistics.legend: Avg. ★ / war = total stars ÷ wars played: unused attacks count as 0. Ties are broken by average destruction, participation and number of wars. Defense ★ = average stars conceded to the opponent (lower is better).

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email: we will send you a link to choose a new one
forgot.sent: If {{email}} is registered, you will shortly receive an email with the link (valid for 1 hour). Check your spam folder too.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose the new password for your account
reset.done: Password updated. For your security you have been signed out of every device: sign in with the new password.
reset.missingToken: The link is incomplete: open it again from the email or request a new one.

SUCCESS.RESET_EMAIL_SENT: If the email is registered, you will receive the link
SUCCESS.VERIFICATION_EMAIL_SENT: Confirmation email sent: check your inbox (and spam).

ERROR.UNAUTHORIZED: You need to sign in to continue.
ERROR.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission for this action.
ERROR.INVALID_TOKEN: Invalid session: please sign in again.
ERROR.INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN: Session expired: please sign in again.
ERROR.ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: Request not allowed from this origin.
ERROR.USERNAME_IS_NOT_VALID: 3 to 24 characters: letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore.
ERROR.PASSWORD_IS_NOT_STRONG_ENOUGH: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.
ERROR.PLAYER_TAG_IS_NOT_VALID: Invalid tag: # followed by 3–15 letters or digits.
ERROR.WAR_SYNC_FAILED: Reading the war from Clash of Clans failed.
ERROR.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts: try again in a few minutes.
ERROR.INCORRECT_PASSWORD: The current password is not correct.
ERROR.INVALID_OR_EXPIRED_RESET_TOKEN: The link is invalid or has expired: request a new one.
ERROR.INVALID_OR_EXPIRED_VERIFY_TOKEN: The confirmation link is invalid or has expired.
ERROR.EMAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED: Sending emails is not enabled yet: contact an administrator.
ERROR.CANNOT_REMOVE_OWN_ADMIN: You cannot remove the administrator role from yourself.
ERROR.HISTORY_NOT_FOUND: No wars recorded in the period.
ERROR.PLAYERS_SYNC_FAILED: Reading the members from Clash of Clans failed.

recruit.title: Join Crociata Nera
recruit.text: We are looking for loyal warriors, ready to fight side by side. Here every attack counts, every star matters and nobody fights alone: bring your village to Crociata Nera.
recruit.full: Our ranks are full: come back soon!
recruit.ctaHint: The link opens Clash of Clans on the clan profile: tap “Join” and wait to be accepted.

wars.title: Endless wars
wars.text: Clan wars and Clan War League every month, with a clear plan and teammates who actually attack.

league.title: In {{league}}
league.text: We compete at the top: every war is a real challenge against worthy clans.

capital.title: Capital level {{n}}
capital.text: Raid weekends every week and a capital to grow together.

clanGames.title: Clan Games always completed
clanGames.text: Every month we reach the top Clan Games tier and never miss an event: the best rewards are for everyone.

cwl.title: Organized, structured CWL
cwl.text: Line-ups, turns and targets planned together: we coordinate on our WhatsApp and Telegram channels, so everyone always knows what to do and when to attack.

redCrusade.title: Crociata Rossa
redCrusade.text: Our sister clan, where we play the second CWL: more League medals and a spot for everyone.

goldCrusade.title: Crociata d'Oro
goldCrusade.text: The parallel wars clan: while the two CWLs are on, we keep fighting clan wars there and the action never stops.

honours.title: Glory to those who earn it
honours.text: Stats for every attack, monthly rankings and bronze, silver and gold commendations for the best.

war.title: Wars and League
war.1: War and Clan War League (CWL) attacks are mandatory
